Technical

Equipment:
 Control valve module

for the 
 runner
Introduction

This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, which must be performed 
on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title 
block

The control valve modules are based on a modular design, fitting location on the 
oil tank module is freely selectable. The return pipes are below the oil level
The following items are fitting on the control valve module:
Servo valve.
Lubrication pump, relive valve, pressure switch and pressure gauge.

items: Lubrication pump, relive valve, pressure switch and pressure gauge.

sections.text: The two control oil circuits:
Main circuit for actuation of the servomotor.

Control oil circuit with fine filter for the oil actuate the servovalves, 
proportional and direction control valves.
